## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope matches the card; no unrelated refactors or renames.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, passwords or real credentials in the diff.
- [ ] Env changes documented in `.env.example` (names only).
- [ ] Contracts/docs and the AC matrix updated when behaviour changed.
- [ ] UI changes include screenshots.
- [ ] `[OPEN-*]` items are stated, not silently resolved.
